paragraphs.text: Camping can be an inexpensive holiday, but families new to it should start with a single night at a site close to home. This allows them to test their equipment and find out what they have forgotten.
Choose a tent that is larger than the number of people suggests. A four-person tent often has room only for four adults lying side by side, with no space for bags.
Sleeping mats are as important as sleeping bags. The ground takes heat from the body during the night, and even in summer campers can feel cold without insulation underneath.
Children usually enjoy camping more when they have jobs to do, such as collecting water or helping to put up the tent.
Always check the weather forecast before leaving, and pack waterproof clothing even if rain is not expected.
Many campsites also rent out equipment, which is a good way to try camping before buying a tent of your own.

items.quote: This allows them to test their equipment and find out what they have forgotten
items.prompt: A first night at a campsite close to home
keywords: find out what they have forgotten

explanation.en: A night near home lets families “find out what they have forgotten” → C. F contradicts the text: camping is called inexpensive.
explanation.kk: Үйге жақын бір түн «find out what they have forgotten» мүмкіндік береді → C. F мәтінге қайшы: кемпинг арзан деп аталған.
explanation.ru: Одна ночь рядом с домом позволяет «find out what they have forgotten» → C. F противоречит тексту: кемпинг назван недорогим.

items.quote: A four-person tent often has room only for four adults lying side by side, with no space for bags
items.prompt: A tent described as being for four people

explanation.en: A “four-person” tent fits four adults lying side by side with no room for bags — less space than the name suggests → A.
explanation.kk: «Төрт адамдық» шатырға тек төрт адам жатады, сөмкеге орын жоқ — атауында айтылғаннан орын аз → A.
explanation.ru: «Четырёхместная» палатка вмещает только четверых лёжа и без места для сумок — места меньше, чем обещает название → A.

items.quote: The ground takes heat from the body during the night

explanation.en: The ground takes body heat, so a mat keeps campers warm → B.
explanation.kk: Жер дене жылуын алады, кілемшесіз суық → B «keeps campers warm by stopping heat loss into the ground».
explanation.ru: Земля забирает тепло тела, и без коврика холодно → B «keeps campers warm by stopping heat loss into the ground».

items.quote: Children usually enjoy camping more when they have jobs to do

explanation.en: “Children usually enjoy camping more when they have jobs to do” → E. G contradicts the example: children help put up the tent.
explanation.kk: «Children usually enjoy camping more when they have jobs to do» → E. G мысалға қайшы: балалар шатыр тігуге көмектеседі.
explanation.ru: «Children usually enjoy camping more when they have jobs to do» → E. G противоречит примеру: дети помогают ставить палатку.

items.quote: pack waterproof clothing even if rain is not expected
keywords: even if rain is not expected

explanation.en: Pack waterproof clothing “even if rain is not expected”. “Forecast is dry” paraphrases that → D.
explanation.kk: Су өткізбейтін киімді «even if rain is not expected» алу керек. «Forecast is dry» — «rain is not expected» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы → D.
explanation.ru: Непромокаемую одежду брать «even if rain is not expected». «Forecast is dry» пересказывает «rain is not expected» → D.

options.text: often has less space than its name suggests.
keeps campers warm by stopping heat loss into the ground.
helps families find out what equipment is missing.
should be packed even when the forecast is dry.
makes children more likely to enjoy the trip.
